title: Daily Review Report
description: Contract for the single fenced json code block in every 'Daily Review — YYYY-MM-DD' issue. The Layer 2 roll-up brief parses this block; a report that does not validate against this schema is treated as a failed review. Emit exactly one such block per issue.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this report. Always the literal integer 1 until this schema file changes it.

date.description: UTC date of the review run, YYYY-MM-DD. Matches the date in the issue title 'Daily Review — YYYY-MM-DD'.

status.description: COMPLETE: every enabled check ran. PARTIAL: some checks ran, some were skipped (each skip listed in 'skipped'). INCOMPLETE: the review could not meaningfully run; treat as a failure, never as a clean bill of health.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the repo's state today, mirroring the prose above the JSON block.

health.description: Repo health snapshot. Only report values actually verified this run; put caveats in 'notes'.

ci_status.description: State of the default branch's most recent CI, e.g. 'passing', 'failing', 'none', 'unknown'.

open_pr_count.description: Number of currently open pull requests.

stale_pr_count.description: Open PRs with no activity for longer than review-config.yml stale_pr_days.

dependency_alerts.description: Count of open dependency/security alerts visible to the reviewer.

secrets_found.description: True if the secret scan found committed secrets. Details go in findings as P0, location and type only — never the value.

notes.description: Freeform caveats about this snapshot (empty string if none), e.g. 'dependency alerts not visible to this token'.

findings.description: Individual defects, capped at review-config.yml max_findings (overflow is summarized, never silently dropped). Empty array means no findings.

id.description: Stable slug of file + problem per CODE_REVIEW.md S7 (e.g. 'src-billing-total-py-float-rounding'). The same defect must get the same id tomorrow — never embed the date, the line number, or the run. The repair layer's 2-attempt lifetime retry budget and the human's dismissals are tracked per finding id across days.

severity.description: P0 critical (secrets, data loss, security) through P3 minor.

file.description: Repo-root-relative path of the primary affected file.

line.description: 1-based line number in 'file', when a single line is identifiable. Omit otherwise.

evidence.description: Concrete evidence per the CODE_REVIEW.md evidence standard: what was observed and why it is a defect. For secrets: location and type only, never the value.

confidence.description: Reviewer's confidence after the refute pass.

suggested_tier.description: Suggested repair tier per REPAIR.md: GREEN may auto-merge, YELLOW waits for a human, RED never merges. Anything touching auth, wallets, signers, or settlement must be RED.

skipped.description: Every enabled check that did not run this pass, with the reason. Required so PARTIAL/INCOMPLETE runs are loud, never silent. Empty array when nothing was skipped.

check.description: Name of the check that was skipped, e.g. 'secret_scan', 'docs_drift', 'S6.6'.

reason.description: Why it was skipped, e.g. 'timeout budget exhausted', 'tool not in allowedTools'.

files_scanned.description: Number of files the reviewer actually examined.

duration_minutes.description: Wall-clock duration of the review run in minutes.
